@pytest.mark.parametrize("selector", [SelectKBest(k=2), VarianceThreshold()])
def test_output_dataframe_preserve_dtypes(selector):
    """Check that the output of a selector keeps the dtypes of the input."""
    pd = pytest.importorskip("pandas")

    X = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "a": np.array([1, 2, 3, 4], dtype=np.float16),
            "b": np.array([4, 1, 3, 2], dtype=np.int8),
            "c": pd.Series(["x", "y", "x", "y"], dtype="category"),
            "d": np.array([0, 0, 0, 0], dtype=np.float32),
        }
    )
    X = X.assign(c=X["c"].cat.codes.astype("int8").astype("category"))
    y = np.array([0, 1, 0, 1])

    selector.set_output(transform="pandas")
    X_out = selector.fit_transform(X[["a", "b", "d"]], y)
    expected = X[["a", "b", "d"]].dtypes[X_out.columns]
    pd.testing.assert_series_equal(X_out.dtypes, expected)
EOF
